title: Pig waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='68' rx='28' ry='22' fill='#f7a8c4'/>
  <!-- Body highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='64' rx='20' ry='14' fill='#ffb8d4'/>
  <!-- Legs -->
  <rect x='28' y='82' width='10' height='12' rx='4' fill='#e888aa'/>
  <rect x='58' y='82' width='10' height='12' rx='4' fill='#e888aa'/>
  <!-- Hooves -->
  <rect x='28' y='90' width='10' height='5' rx='2' fill='#d4709a'/>
  <rect x='58' y='90' width='10' height='5' rx='2' fill='#d4709a'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx='48' cy='40' r='24' fill='#f7a8c4'/>
  <!-- Head highlight -->
  <circle cx='48' cy='36' r='17' fill='#ffb8d4'/>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <polygon points='28,24 38,14 42,28' fill='#f7a8c4'/>
  <polygon points='68,24 58,14 54,28' fill='#f7a8c4'/>
  <polygon points='31,24 37,18 40,27' fill='#ffb8d4'/>
  <polygon points='65,24 59,18 56,27' fill='#ffb8d4'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='39' cy='36' r='4' fill='#4a2040'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='36' r='4' fill='#4a2040'/>
  <!-- Eye shine -->
  <circle cx='40.5' cy='34.5' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='58.5' cy='34.5' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- Snout -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='48' rx='10' ry='7' fill='#e888aa'/>
  <!-- Nostrils -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='48' rx='2' ry='3' fill='#c06088'/>
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='48' rx='2' ry='3' fill='#c06088'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M42 54 Q48 59 54 54' stroke='#c06088' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Blush -->
  <ellipse cx='31' cy='46' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#ff7aa8' opacity='0.6'/>
  <ellipse cx='65' cy='46' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#ff7aa8' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- Waving arm -->
  <path d='M68 62 Q80 50 82 36' stroke='#e888aa' stroke-width='8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Waving hand/hoof -->
  <circle cx='82' cy='34' r='6' fill='#d4709a'/>
  <!-- Other arm -->
  <path d='M24 66 Q16 74 14 80' stroke='#e888aa' stroke-width='8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='14' cy='80' r='5' fill='#d4709a'/>
  <!-- Curly tail -->
  <path d='M76 72 Q86 68 82 60 Q78 54 74 60' stroke='#e888aa' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
